items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: they were working with fellow named Bendy Howard

ctx.x: Well, where was he making his name

He started, him and Bob Robertson, the one that sponsored me in masons, they were working with fellow named Bendy Howard, had a band on 140th Street and Lenox, called the Calvert Palace. It was a good band. It was eight pieces.
